sources.title: GitHub - philgear/pocketgull: An Integrative Health App to Assist ...
sources.snippet: Pocket Gull streamlines patient intake with an interactive 3D body map and AI-powered clinical intelligence. It empowers practitioners with rapid data visualization and strategy synthesis for proactive care decisions, acting as an interruptible voice-first clinical co-pilot.

sources.title: Pocket Gull | Real-Time Clinical AI & FHIR Care Strategy
sources.snippet: Pocket Gull is a real-time medical care plan strategy and live AI consult engine powered by Google Gemini. Features 10D diagnostic paradigms, FHIR R4 interoperability, and 3D spatial anatomy.
